phase_b.scope: TEST ONLY: 3 existing files, 13 prior CI cases; immutable additive five-case patch is unchanged and not included. No JVM/Maven/formatter/commit/push.
phase_b.validation: Static diff/check/line-length only; owner must run all 13 replacement cases.

hit_proof.liveness: Real mdb_get is counted, DBI must be adjacency metadata and key exactly type 7 + 8-byte ID. Any native cursor method fails. Each nonsentinel candidate must cause exactly one read, independent of PO budget; all four positions, duplicate logical writes, cross-plane/cross-row reference multiplicity, rollback and final deletion are asserted.
hit_proof.snapshot: A real SailDataset is materialized and prefix/root plans captured before a distinct statement commit. Exact RDF revision +1, old 50/new 51, absent/present new subject, disjoint root partitions, prefix counts, supported orders and parallel-source admission are asserted.
hit_proof.preferences: Every one of 24 preferences reopens the same nonempty explicit/inferred store. Exact native DB names and raw pages/metadata/deltas maps must remain unchanged; RDF revision begins at zero with no mutation. Namespace-native commits are allowed across constructors; only repeated compatibility scheduling must not invent a native commit. Exact independent unsigned-ordered rows and both-direction/count/reference helper are checked.
hit_proof.corruption: Actual native format value overwritten with 3 or 8192 bytes, normal constructor must throw. Entire nonvolatile directory snapshot must remain unchanged (shared fixture excludes lock and lock.mdb); actual valid bytes restored, full raw authority and both-plane model required on fresh reopen.

mapping.preserved_guarantee: Predicate-leading but non-PO order cannot manufacture proof of object absence.
An IRI potentially used as subject cannot be reclaimed without subject proof; absent literals can be reclaimed.
An IRI potentially used as predicate cannot be reclaimed without predicate proof; absent literal can be reclaimed.
An inferred-only live object must never be called unused just because explicit-plane probe consumed budget.
Liveness work is bounded rather than proportional to statement multiplicity.
High predicate cardinality cannot cause unbounded scans or lose unresolved backlog; finite batches make safe progress.
A budget-exhausted probe without an UNKNOWN collector must fail conservatively rather than reclaim a live ID.
Opening with changed preferences must not prematurely replace/drop durable data before a safe authority transition.
Unknown liveness must not return an ID as safely unused, and proof must avoid unbounded statement scans.
Corrupt/oversized build descriptor must not destroy active authoritative trees; repeated starts cannot spawn duplicate writers.
Repeated use of all 24 permutations preserves exact rows and bounds native DBI count without leaking physical generations.
Held SailDataset uses its own original generation for supported orders, prefix runs, root partitions and parallel-source admission while fresh readers see current generation.
